verdict: No paid campaigns running; organic reach alone is not filling the pipeline.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all lead generation has rested entirely on your Google Business Profile, with no paid advertising active on Meta or Google. GBP delivered 98 total actions this period — 24 calls, 38 direction requests, and 36 website clicks — but that activity dropped sharply in the last 7 days, with the final three days of the window showing no recorded actions at all. Instagram reach climbed 44% over the same 7-day stretch, but that exposure has not translated into leads or booked appointments. We are working to restore active paid campaigns so you are not solely dependent on organic visibility that is currently declining.
